claims.head: The Stars’ power play outclasses the Sabres’
claims.body: On the power play, Dallas is one of the league’s best, but Buffalo is near the bottom. Every penalty the Sabres take could cost them.

claims.head: Where the Stars have the edge: shots from defensemen
claims.body: The Stars are around the middle of the league for shots from defensemen, and the Sabres are near the bottom. That’s the biggest gap between these two, and it isn’t a big one.

BUF.head: The Sabres have a slight edge
BUF.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Buffalo has home-ice advantage. Still, it’s close: the Stars can make it interesting if their penalty kill holds up.
